fieldData.acrm---key-feature-5-content:
Answers that reach a named person

Sends a Slack or email alert to the staff member who owns an answer, such as a latex allergy to whoever preps the exam room, with reminders until someone marks it seen.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { annualUpdates: "My internal medicine practice needs a yearly medical history update. Send returning patients last year's answers 7 days before each annual physical, and let them confirm each section or edit it. Mark every changed answer, such as a new prescription or a recent operation, and show those changes first when the doctor opens the chart.", familyHistory: "Build a family history section for my family practice's new patient form. Give each relative a row with the relationship, the condition, and the age at diagnosis. When a parent, brother, or sister has a condition, list it at the top of the summary our doctor reads before the first visit, with other relatives below.", preSurgeryChecks: "My surgery center needs a pre-op medical history form that patients finish 5 days before their procedure. If the medication list includes a blood thinner, or the patient reports a past problem with anesthesia, email Hana Okafor, our pre-op nurse, with the patient's name and procedure date so she can call them.", campScreenings: "Build a health screening form for my day camp that parents fill in for each camper before the first day. Ask about allergies, medicines taken during camp hours, and whether the camper carries an epinephrine auto-injector. Add any camper with a yes to the list our camp nurse keeps at the first-aid station, and collect a parent's signature." };
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a medical history form that saves every response to a database I own.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: Walter Brandt's pre-op history, finished 5 days before his hernia repair, lists warfarin; the blood thinner rule sends pre-op nurse Hana Okafor an email.
